BETA v1.1.1a (19 June 2019) |previous_update = [[BETA v1.0]] |next_update = [[BETA v1.2|The Heights Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''BETA v1.1''' was the second update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 16th of June 2019, two days after [[BETA v1.0]]. It added the [[Militant|John]] tower, reworked the [[Paintballer]], while also adding new enemies and maps. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''BETA v1.1''' has been retroactively applied to this update. This version encompassed four updates, the main BETA v1.1.0 update (released 16 June 2019) and three minor versions, the BETA v1.1.0a (released 16 June 2019), BETA v1.1.1 (released 18 June 2019) and BETA v1.1.1a (released 19 June 2019). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Militant|John]] ===Enemies=== *[[Tank|Tank 1]] *[[Boomer 1]] *[[Super Mystery|Mystery 2]] ===Maps=== :In '''BETA v1.1.1'''
